appDescription: A passenger motion-sickness care app that adjusts the cabin air for the seat of the affected passenger and suggests a rest stop.

function.name: MOTION_SICKNESS_RELIEF
function.description: Start relief for a passenger who feels motion sick by raising the air flow to the maximum and suggesting a rest stop. Pass the seat only when the user names where the affected passenger sits.

seat.description: The seat of the affected passenger: FRONT_PASSENGER is next to the driver, and the SECOND_ROW and THIRD_ROW values name the row counted from the front and the side as seen from the driver seat. Leave it out when the user does not say.

function.name: MOTION_SICKNESS_RECOVERED
function.description: End the relief when the passenger feels better and return the cabin air to its previous settings.

function.name: OPEN_MOTIONCARE
function.description: Open the motion-sickness care app on the screen.
